Brief assumed Metals (Mining) would be bullish, but Sektor barang baku terjun 4.34%.
Brief assumed Pharmaceuticals would be bearish, but Sektor kesehatan menanjak 0.07%.
Brief assumed Consumer Goods would be bearish, but Sektor barang konsumsi primer naik 0.05% while non-primer fell.
lessons: Ketika IHSG diprediksi Bearish dengan Foreign Flow Stagnant, tetapi Rupiah melemah signifikan sebesar 3.499% dan sektor energi merosot 2.91% meskipun harga minyak mentah naik, maka IHSG ditutup Bearish sebesar -0.44%.
Ketika sektor Energy dan Metals diprediksi Bullish, tetapi Sektor energi merosot 2.91% dan Sektor barang baku terjun 4.34%, maka IHSG ditutup Bearish sebesar -0.44%.
Ketika sektor Pharmaceuticals diprediksi Bearish, tetapi Sektor kesehatan menanjak 0.07%, maka IHSG ditutup Bearish sebesar -0.44%.
summary: The market correctly predicted a bearish IHSG close at -0.44% and stagnant foreign flow, but several sector predictions were incorrect, notably Energy and Metals, while the Rupiah weakened significantly more than anticipated.
